item.title: Issue #2996 created
item.description:
IETF MIME Type Registrations

We may need to revise the IETF MIME type registrations for XSLT and XQuery, in particular to update the security sections.

In the meantime, it might be a good idea to remove Appendix F from the XQuery specification: this is a copy of the old MIME type registration that now needs updating. (For XSLT, this has already been done.)
